name: @qf-jarvis/control-plane-read-contract
description: QF Jarvis governed read-only control-plane snapshot contract (JOS-01B, ADR-0086). One strict, versioned, framework-neutral JSON contract describing what the Jarvis OS operator surface may render, shared verbatim by the web client today and by a future authenticated Android client. It is a READ contract and cannot express authority: there is no canSend, canExecute, isAuthorized, consentValid, approvalGranted or dispatchAllowed, no credential, no contact detail, and no method. Every operational section carries explicit availability and provenance, so an unconnected source renders as NOT_CONNECTED rather than as a successful zero. Depends on zod only -- no Next, no React, no Node API, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no database, no provider, no Core or n8n client, and no process.env.
